limitations: Generated alpha is near-transparent/near-opaque rather than binary: bottom 4 rows minimum about 0.973 and mean about 0.992. This study preserves original alpha; production solid-ground acceptance remains pending.
This is a compressed art-direction inference, not a surveyed Gamcheon-Yangsan road, GIS trace, landmark replica or verified camera direction.

The generated panorama does not preserve the existing endpoint pixels. Original city owners remain unchanged; departure/arrival, reverse travel and reload continuity are implementation approval gates.
Far terrain and buildings share one plate in this first study. Foreground road/posts scroll independently. Full multi-depth city/mountain layering is not implemented.
CSS one-shot motion and the existing base sprite illustrate pacing; actual driving, upgrades, events, weather, braking and save code are not connected.
Native generation was 2172x724, not the requested 3072x1024. At 200% strip width the 2160px delivery provides 1080 source pixels per visible viewport, without upscaling or column warping.
